baseline_description: Previous observed 20-ms spike count. previous_repeat_force permits the force substitution from the immediately preceding matched trial at identical source times.
history: At cutoff t (zero-based row in ms), ten complete bins t-199 through t. Each bin holds the three mean raw device-force axes, source-discriminated spike count and time in seconds at its right edge.
limits: Offline impulse discrimination on a 1 kHz deposited event grid. Device load differs from local skin strain and voluntary movement. Strict zero source-invalid flags on both trials, consecutive columns with same material/direction, finite force on both histories, finite binary events on current history and target. Independent sample size is people.
source: Delhaye et al. (2021), eLife 64679; Zenodo 4818439, CC BY 4.0. Passive robotic loading of a supported fingertip.
target: Direct afferent spike count at source rows t+21 through t+40 inclusive, following a 20 ms gap. The forecast origin starts at t=200 and advances by 20 ms.
